content: Guidance for children on mobile: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size Minimum AA = 24px, but WCAG 2.1 2.5.5 = 44px and Google Material/Apple recommend 48dp; experts recommend the larger sizes for children with developing motor skills. Base font size 16px minimum (digital.gov); use relative font scaling; WCAG 2.2 adds Focus Not Obscured, Dragging, Target Size. Respect reduced-motion, provide dark mode, avoid tiny tap targets and hover-only interactions.
